items.title: Zackory Erickson Earns NSF CAREER Award for Generative Simulation in Physical Human-Robot Interaction
items.summary_en: Zackory Erickson, an assistant professor at Carnegie Mellon's Robotics Institute, has received a National Science Foundation CAREER Award for a project titled 'Scaling Up Physical Human-Robot Interaction With Generative Simulation.' The project aims to build a framework that generates large volumes of physically realistic simulated human-robot interaction scenarios to address the shortage of real-world training data, and to develop AI methods that help robots adapt to human behavior while catching safety issues before real-world deployment. The award also funds integration of this work into CMU robotics courses and a high-school summer program.
